A FEW COMMON QUESTIONS

Let’s clear things up.

What is the fairest way to split rent?

There is no universal formula. Equal shares can suit similar rooms; a shared-space and room-size method can account for different bedrooms. Choose a method everyone understands and agrees to. Compare the options.

How should we split utilities?

Divide agreed shared bills separately from rent. For equal shares, usage-based bills, and partial months, use the utilities guide.

What if two people share one bedroom?

Allocate private costs once per room and shared costs per person. Our couples and shared bedrooms guide walks through an example. The simple calculator divides rent equally by person.

Do you save my numbers?

No. Calculations run in your browser. This site uses no analytics, accounts, or tracking cookies. Your hosting provider still handles ordinary page requests. Read about the site.
